decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list for actual backpacks rather than camping accessories like stoves or pillows. My consideration set includes a mix of casual sling bags, cooler backpacks, and hydration packs. I ultimately chose the NICGID Sling Bag (prod_backpacks_159) because of its high rating (4.5) and massive review count (nearly 4,000), indicating a proven track record. It is priced competitively at $26.99 and fits the needs of a versatile day-trip bag. This purchase moves the overall session statistics closer to the target purchase rate.
